newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BEER SALES, PRODUCTION RISE IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: BEER SALES, PRODUCTION RISE IN MAY.

text.p: Sales and production of beer rose in May compared with April and Klaipeda brewer Svyturys led the market last month, the Brewers Association said on Wednesday.
It said in a statement that total sales rose in May to 1.19 million decalitres from April's 964,000 decalitres while production in May climbed to 1.22 million decalitres from 985,000 decalitres.
The Svyturys brewer of the port town of Klaipeda had the most sales and output in May at 285,000 decalitres and 292,000 decalitres respectively.
Kalnapilis was second-placed at 272,000 decalitres and 279,000 decalitres while usual leader Utenos was third at 271,000 decalitres of sales and 274,000 decalitres of output.
